principles.name: Inherit, don't redefine
principles.statement: Wave 6 inherits parent + Wave 1-5 contracts (SSR p99 ≤500ms, SSE p99 ≤2s, WorkflowBridgePort + 4 Wave 5 extensions, SURFACE_CATALOG, ADR-0063 doc suite). NEW: WBP extensions for on-call ack/resolve + incident timeline emission.

principles.name: Operate against canonical telemetry, not synthetic
principles.statement: Wave 6 surfaces consume real per-tenant telemetry from Wave 4 observability + Foundry audit chain (M02-P04). No mock dashboards.

principles.name: Per-tenant quota CONFIGURATION + ENFORCEMENT
principles.statement: Wave 5 enforces per-tenant TCP/DB/queue/CPU quotas via oya-shared-ontology-bulkhead-port; Wave 6 adds tenant-admin CONFIGURATION UI. Quota config surface is tenant-private gated by Wave 5 fragments.

principles.name: FinOps cost data is internal-public + tenant-private
principles.statement: Per-tenant cost view + chargeback reports + usage forecast are internal-public for SRE + tenant-private for own-tenant. Cross-tenant comparison requires internal-foundry role.

principles.name: On-call is internal-sre/internal-foundry tier
principles.statement: On-call rotation + escalation + ack/resolve UI is internal-sre (Wave 5 ops-internal-sre.cedar). Cross-team on-call requires ops-internal-foundry.cedar. Tenant principals NEVER see on-call data.

principles.name: Incident timeline emits audit-chain rows
principles.statement: Every incident state transition (declared/acked/SEV-changed/resolved/postmortem-published) emits audit-chain row per ADR-0003. Postmortem ledger internal-public; raw timeline internal-sre+.

principles.name: Per-tenant trace/log search
principles.statement: Wave 6 adds tenant-scoped trace search (Tempo) + log search (Loki); gated by ops-tenant-private.cedar (tenant-admin own-tenant) + ops-internal-sre.cedar (cross-tenant SRE).

principles.name: CLI parity for every UI action
principles.statement: Every Wave 6 UI action MUST have equivalent oya-cli invocation. Same underlying WorkflowBridgePort call. Verified via lean-a-cli-parity lane (BLOCKER day 1).

decision_drivers.statement: First paying tenant + 100-tenant scale-out gates Wave 6 completion (deadline 2026-09-12). Without capacity + finops + on-call + incident, support cannot triage at scale; PLG blocked.
Active-artifact-contract v3.0.0 conformance from day 1 (per ADR-0069 + commits 3d6de67 + b0798b0). Every artifact registered with artifact_profile + capability statuses.
Reuse Wave 5 primitives. WriteActionTokenStore + ApprovalTicketStore + bulkhead-port + 12 Cedar fragments + multi-party-approval Rule 1/Rule 2. New blocks only when no Wave 5 primitive fits.

viable_options.label: 4 BCs at M04-P06 with active-artifact-contract conformance + CLI parity + trace/log search + audit-chain emission
viable_options.strengths: Single coherent operator-readiness surface; 100-tenant scale-out unblocked; CLI parity enforced day 1; reuses 100% Wave 5 primitives
viable_options.costs: Largest M04 wave (~40 artifacts); 4 NEW Cedar fragments; coordinates with M02-P12 owner sign-off
viable_options.risks: Trace/log search latency at 1000-tenant scale; FinOps cost data freshness vs billing-source; Wave 4 must be operational

viable_options.label: Defer on-call + incident to Wave 7; ship only capacity + finops in Wave 6
viable_options.strengths: Lower fan-out; on-call/incident builds on Wave 7 audit-view context
viable_options.costs: First-paying-tenant ops support requires on-call+incident day 1
viable_options.risks: Customer un-supported escalation; SOC2 incident control impossible; M04-P06 falls behind

viable_options.label: Split into Wave 6.A (capacity+finops) + Wave 6.B (on-call+incident)
viable_options.costs: Masterplan churn; 6.A→6.B handoff drift; CLI parity ambiguous

viable_options.label: Skip CLI parity (UI-only)
viable_options.costs: Wave 5 v18 §12.6 commits CLI parity in Wave 6 expansion

bc_inventory.subtotal_summary: 25 BC crates + 5 shared extensions + 4 NEW Cedar fragments + 5 NEW fitness lanes + 2 NEW WBP method extensions = ~41 artifacts net new at Wave 6.

scenarios.name: Tenant quota config race
scenarios.failure_mode: Two concurrent quota-set ops with different values; final state indeterminate
scenarios.prevention: WriteActionTokenStore idempotency on tenant_quota_set action_type; 7-step verify
scenarios.recovery: Read-after-write returns last-tracked value with Last-Modified header

scenarios.name: FinOps cost data drift
scenarios.failure_mode: Cloud invoice vs metering differ; chargeback wrong
scenarios.prevention: Nightly oya-ops-finops-batch-aggregator reconciles metering vs invoice; alert when |delta|>2%
scenarios.recovery: Tenant-admin audit per-line-item; emit audit-chain row

scenarios.name: On-call paging missed
scenarios.prevention: 3-retry + 30s backoff + fallback rotation; audit per attempt
scenarios.recovery: SEV-1 auto-escalate to secondary; runbook covers manual

scenarios.name: Incident timeline emission lost
scenarios.failure_mode: Workflow crashes between state-change and audit emit
scenarios.prevention: Same 7-step verify as Wave 5 rollback; incident_state_change action_type with reconciler

scenarios.name: Per-tenant trace search at 1000-tenant scale
scenarios.prevention: Per-tenant trace-store sharding via Wave 5 bulkhead extension; budget 2s p99 in lean-a-trace-search-perf lane
scenarios.recovery: Degrade to time-narrow UI prompt; emit budget-breach metric

scenarios.name: FinOps cross-tenant data leak
scenarios.failure_mode: Tenant-admin Y views tenant Z costs
scenarios.prevention: NEW ops-finops-cost-scope.cedar predicate principal.tenant_id == resource.tenant_id; red-team probe

scenarios.name: CLI parity drift
scenarios.failure_mode: UI ships action; CLI not updated
scenarios.prevention: lean-a-cli-parity lane BLOCKER day 1; scans OpenAPI vs oya-cli-router registry
scenarios.recovery: PR-time fail; author adds CLI command

scenarios.name: Postmortem publication race
scenarios.prevention: WriteActionTokenStore idempotency on postmortem_publish; SEV-1 requires 2-of-N internal-foundry approval
scenarios.recovery: Second writer gets 409 with first's ticket_id
